children: Quan announced an approximately US$18.8 million purchase agreement for NVIDIA GPU-powered infrastructure to build its XDT AI cloud business.
Entered ~US$18.8M agreement (signed Sept 16, 2026) to acquire NVIDIA GPU computing infrastructure for XDT.
XDT aims to provide managed AI computing capacity so clients can develop, run and scale AI apps without owning infrastructure.
First U.S. AI infrastructure hub expected to be operational from Q4 2026, subject to delivery and deployment.
XDT is positioned to drive recurring revenue aligned with customer demand, funding and operational readiness.
Transaction advances Quan’s Quantum and AI Systems strategy alongside its Quantum Life Sciences, Advanced Nuclear and Quantum-Safe Cybersecurity efforts.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Quan Advances AI Cloud XDT with US$18.8M NVIDIA GPU Infrastructure Purchase
